audit.provenance: Rebuilt from authoritative LIVE v86 English generator. Not a paid-order download; not proven historical-byte-identical.

screenReview.findings: No new obvious overflow, clipped cards or missing props in the reconstructed English layouts.

assessment: Five-stage English mainline can finish under its staged adult-led instructions; current program checks passing does not remove the usability/design findings below. Rebuild is not a live paid-order download or historical byte-identity proof.

findings.observed: One star alone selects M-27 uniquely. Arc count narrows to two candidates. Teacher requires both marks but also says at least one explained mark is accepted.
findings.proposal: Draw actual monochrome intake marks and ledger marks; revise the M-72 distractor from (1 arc,2 stars) to (1 arc,1 star), preserving the ID. Then either feature alone leaves two candidates; both yield one. Require both pieces of evidence consistently.

findings.observed: Optional role cuts share a page with the permanent evidence record. Three case-tag cuts share the page with the gallery task, placement plan and response field. This is not a claim that all rules disappear after these cuts.
findings.proposal: Keep role page whole; make progress an evidence index, not repeated answers. Separate intact gallery task from three-case-tag cut page. All necessary rules remain on the task page actually distributed.

findings.topic: All correct assembly identifiers are A
findings.observed: TOP A, DIAL A and BASE A are all correct. All actual pictures and three independent slips exist.
findings.proposal: Remove answer-pattern A/B identifiers; distinguish six cards by role/feature label and drawing, or use shuffled neutral IDs. Match actual monochrome drawings to text.

findings.observed: Archive note B states This is a different object. The known object name also makes it easier to discard without checking accession ID.
findings.proposal: Remove disqualifying prose and answer-coded names as the deciding signal; make the distractor a plausible same-family archive record. Require two matching accession IDs and cite each source for the authored label. Do not preselect trusted source letters on the blank label.

findings.topic: Low-cut and small-team path needs explicit propagation
findings.observed: English already provides a two-pupil path: adult holds/reads slip3. Low-cut is explained near the end of the guide; most preparation, play and reset sections still assume 12 pieces and cut parts.
findings.proposal: Standard12 pieces versus low-cut3 private slips; announce the chosen mode before printing. Carry both modes through handouts, actions, pass conditions, display and reset. For Chinese default two-pupil play, allocate one slip and two slips, one at a time, with no person holding all three. Describe three independent evidence sources, not three required pupil holders.

findings.topic: Hosting, record reuse and visitor reveal
findings.observed: Role rotation is generic; several results are recorded both in tasks and the central record; teacher actions contain solutions on the same page; peer visiting does not explicitly require both crews to finish mission4; player audit page contains the celebration.
findings.proposal: Explicit fixed-seat 2–6 pupil mission tables announced by teacher; progress indexes original work. Separate operation from adult answer pages; label strong hints. Explain flat-paper assembly and transfer existing selected parts to the exhibit. Pair visitors only after both crews finish mission4; teacher is visitor for a lone crew; repair/recheck only the failed item. Adult reads ending only after pass.
